Our slim straight jean with a low/medium rise made from our brand new 14oz broken twill selvedge denim. Broken twill denim was first used in 1964 by Wrangler as a solution for combatting leg twist. The process of weaving fabric in this method sees the combination of both right hand twill (RHT) and left hand twill (LHT) reversed every two warp ends, forming a zigzag-like pattern in the denim and resulting in no bias in either direction of the weave, therefore eliminating leg twist.

Our signature penny loafer, now rendered in Copper Alicante suede — a reverse calf full grain suede sourced from the renowned Tanneries du Puy in France. This exceptional material is crafted from premium full grain hides, meticulously reversed to reveal a naturally dense, velvety nap. p-ironheart-10454695018762.d: Chup will boast that their "Life Long" socks might possibly be the last socks you buy. Knitted with Invista's highly durable material, Cordura®, which is 7 times as strong as normal yarn and gives amazing durability of 6 to 10 times that of ordinary cotton socks (scientifically tested and verified). These socks include Cordura yarn from top to bottom, not just in the heel, toe and sole (the minimum for socks to be able to use the Cordura name). Subject to abrasion testing for wear, to pass they must survive 500 times - Chup's "Life Long" socks clear the abrasion test more than 30,000 times. So they may not be indestructible, but they do wear extremely well (as Giles, their biggest fan, will testify).
